SELECT menu.raw_id, menu.item_id, menu.kind, menu.category_id, menu.name, menu.price, menu.description, menu.status, menu.stock, menu.tags, menu.art, menu.image FROM ( SELECT d.id AS raw_id, d.id * 2 AS item_id, 'dish' AS kind, d.category_id, c.sort AS category_sort, d.name, d.price, d.description, d.status, d.stock, d.tags, d.art, d.image FROM dish d JOIN category c ON c.id = d.category_id WHERE d.status = 1 AND c.status = 1 AND c.type = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT s.id AS raw_id, s.id * 2 + 1 AS item_id, 'setmeal' AS kind, s.category_id, c.sort AS category_sort, s.name, s.price, s.description, s.status, s.stock, s.tags, s.art, s.image FROM setmeal s JOIN category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 1 AND c.status = 1 AND c.type = 2 ) menu
AND menu.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND menu.status = #{query.status}
AND menu.name LIKE #{namePattern} ESCAPE '!'
ORDER BY menu.category_sort, menu.category_id, menu.item_id
